assessment: After mating, animals show a repertoire of behavioural changes. In flies, this includes an increase in egg-laying, salt, and food (particularly protein) consumption, and a concomitant decrease in sexual receptivity. This valuable study compellingly shows that flies also have an increased sugar appetite and they identify the central brain circuitry that controls this increase in the mated condition.
